enemy-051-ceto-reef-predator.designLock: Original Tantalus Frontier aquatic fauna with no external model: one streamlined amphibious quadruped predator in strict right-facing orthographic profile, with one flat wedge head, lateral natural eye, visible gill slits, short neck, long tapered trunk, exactly four articulated weight-capable paddle limbs, one low dorsal crest and one deep non-bladed caudal swimming fin. Preserve the V56 identity, 186x82 logical runtime envelope, stable aquatic center/root, body length, head size, crest height and caudal depth across all 32 future poses. Materials are organic blue-black/deep-green wet hide with fine dark plates, subtle reef abrasion and only restrained cyan flank bioluminescence. Never add xenomorph anatomy, biomechanical metal, walking legs during swim, extra fins, leviathan scale or full-body neon. All future pixels must be original project art, canonExact=false.

clips.lockedMotion: Eight near-stationary phases: gill pulse, restrained trunk breath, paddle trim, gentle caudal counterwave and seamless return without root drift.
Eight chronological swim phases driven by alternating body/caudal wave and four paddle-limb trims; seamless cycle, no walking gait.
Eight phases: compress wave, fix target right, tail thrust, forward lunge, single-jaw contact, follow-through, paddle brake and recovery.
Eight irreversible aquatic phases: lethal impact, propulsion loss, body curl, uncontrolled sink/roll kept in profile, paddle slack, tail sag and motionless terminal pose.

designDetails.silhouette: Streamlined amphibious quadruped predator: flat wedge head, short neck, long tapered trunk, four articulated paddle-limbs, deep swimming tail fin and low dorsal crest.
designDetails.palette: Blue-black and deep green wet skin with fine dark plates; very restrained cyan flank bioluminescence.
designDetails.surface: Organic wet hide and fine plates, subtle reef abrasion and salt/mineral wear; never biomechanical or metallic.
designDetails.anatomy: One flat head, lateral natural eye, visible gill slits, one jaw, four weight-capable paddle limbs, one deep non-bladed swimming tail. No xenomorph organs.
designDetails.orientation: strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; eye, gills, four limbs and caudal fin remain readable
designDetails.scale: V56 runtime envelope 186x82 logical pixels with ceto-reef-predator-water hitbox. Lock body length, head size, dorsal crest height and caudal depth across clips.
designDetails.root: Use a stable aquatic center/root and constant vertical waterline; grounded idle wording means no uncontrolled drift. Preserve full tail and paddles inside each cell.
designDetails.background: true transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no water scene, bubbles, shadow, reflection or gradient
designDetails.cellBounds: one complete animal per cell, generous equal gutter, no crop, overlap, boundary contact or cross-cell glow
prohibitions: aquatic xenomorph, blind dome, inner jaw, dorsal tubes or acid
